about.sectionSubtitle: I'm a passionate Software Developer based in Lagos, Nigeria, with hands-on experience building complete web solutions — from pixel-perfect frontends to robust backend systems. I specialise in school management portals, e-commerce platforms, institutional websites, and foundation platforms that solve real problems for real people.
about.heading: Software Developer & Entrepreneur
about.intro: Building end-to-end digital solutions across Nigeria — from school portals and student management systems to NGO websites, institutional platforms, and entrepreneurial ventures.
about.body: I've successfully delivered multi-portal systems — including student, admin, and staff portals — institutional websites, and NGO platforms. I take pride in shipping production-ready systems that work reliably for schools, foundations, and organisations across Nigeria.

skills.sectionSubtitle: A full stack skill set — comfortable on both sides of the stack and everything in between.

resume.sectionSubtitle: My journey as a self-driven software developer, building real-world applications that serve institutions and communities across Nigeria.
